zh.d:
本版重做了 Windows 安装体验：安装器实时展示安装阶段与解压进度，支持长路径，安装或卸载失败能自动收集本地诊断，包体也更小；更新源升级为「新桶优先、旧桶兜底」的双桶容灾。同时修复浏览器预览页签跨会话串内容、定时任务工作区恢复两大问题，技能文档修改与 Windows OCR 更稳。

【新增】
· 【安装器】实时显示安装阶段与解压活动：安装过程不再是一根进度条跑到底，能看清当前步骤与解压动态
· 【安装器】安装/卸载失败自动收集本地诊断：一键复制诊断信息或打开日志文件夹，排障不用再猜；卸载失败路径同样覆盖
· 【定时任务】任务编辑器支持显式恢复工作区：一键找回任务工作区，配置与历史都不丢（配套服务端恢复逻辑同步落地）

【修复】
· 【安装器】支持 Windows 长路径：解压深层目录文件不再失败
· 【安装器】包体更小：裁掉未使用的 ACP 声明与 source map，下载安装更快
· 【浏览器预览】页签跟随所属会话：预览面板跨会话不再串内容，Agent 自动开面板按会话归属门控
· 【桌面】升级恢复下载改用系统浏览器打开，不再被内嵌窗口卡住
· 【桌面】启动被阻断的画面（如初始化失败）提供原生退出按钮，不必再杀进程
· 【技能】修改现有文档走轻量路径；Windows OCR 输出固定 UTF-8，中文识别不再乱码

【优化改进】
· 【更新】更新源双桶容灾：客户端优先新下载桶，新桶不通自动回退旧桶，更新链路更稳
· 【界面】通知与消息提示整体缩小一号：Notification 标题 14/正文 12/图标 16，Message 12px，更轻量不遮挡
· 【桌面】打包数据与已安装配置目录隔离，避免测试数据混入正式环境

本版企业侧与服务端共享两项后端修复，客户端更新链路同步双桶容灾。

【修复】
· 【定时任务】任务工作区恢复逻辑在企业服务端同步生效：恢复不丢配置与历史
· 【技能】修改现有文档走轻量路径；Windows OCR 输出固定 UTF-8，中文识别不再乱码

【优化改进】
· 【更新】企业版客户端更新源双桶容灾：优先新下载桶，新桶不通自动回退旧桶

en.d:
This release rebuilds the Windows install experience: the installer now shows real install stages and extraction activity, supports long paths, collects local diagnostics on failed installs or uninstalls, and ships smaller. The update source gains dual-bucket failover (new bucket first, legacy bucket as fallback). It also fixes browser preview tabs leaking across conversations, adds scheduled-task workspace recovery, and makes skill document edits and Windows OCR more reliable.

[New]
· Installer: real install stages and extraction activity — you can see the current step and unpacking progress instead of a single indeterminate bar
· Installer: failed installs or uninstalls collect local diagnostics automatically — copy them or open the log folder with one click; uninstall failure paths are covered too
· Cron: the task editor supports explicit workspace recovery — one click brings the workspace back with configuration and history intact (matched by the server-side recovery logic)

[Fixed]
· Installer: Windows long-path support — extracting into deep directories no longer fails
· Installer: smaller package — unused ACP declarations and source maps are trimmed, downloads and installs finish faster
· Browser preview: tabs now follow their owning conversation — the preview panel no longer mixes content across conversations, and agent-opened panels are gated by conversation ownership
· Desktop: upgrade-recovery downloads open in the system browser instead of getting stuck in an embedded window
· Desktop: blocked startup screens (e.g. failed initialization) now offer a native quit button — no more killing processes
· Skills: editing existing documents takes the lightweight path; Windows OCR output is pinned to UTF-8, so Chinese recognition no longer garbles

[Improved]
· Updates: dual-bucket failover for the update source — clients prefer the new download bucket and fall back to the legacy bucket automatically
· UI: notifications and messages are one size smaller across the board — Notification title 14/body 12/icon 16, Message 12px, lighter and less obtrusive
· Desktop: packaged test data is isolated from installed profiles so test fixtures never leak into real environments

This release shares two backend fixes with the enterprise server, and the client update path gains dual-bucket failover.

[Fixed]
· Cron: task workspace recovery applies on the enterprise server as well — recovery keeps configuration and history
· Skills: editing existing documents takes the lightweight path; Windows OCR output is pinned to UTF-8, so Chinese recognition no longer garbles

[Improved]
· Updates: enterprise clients get dual-bucket failover — the new download bucket first, automatic fallback to the legacy bucket
